The '''Mon Cala Special Forces''' was a [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit from [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]] made up of members from the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. One member of the Mon Cala Special Forces was [[Loku Kanoloa/Legends|Loku Kanoloa]], who performed several missions before leaving the forces to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="Constant Vigilance" />
